text_block_list.text:
Since Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi wasn't feeling 
well, the two of us came to the shrine to 
pray, when—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what a coincidence! Did you come to 
pray too, King-chan?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just doing a bit while training— 
Wait, what is with all that luggage!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
This? This is a cleaning kit. I was 
thinking of cleaning up the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We're asking for our prayers to be 
heard... so this level of sincerity is 
only natural!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The priest said it was okay too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm... You certainly have a point there.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fine! The King shall lend a hand too. 
After all, I can't be indebted to a deity!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: R-Really? Thank you so much~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Look, under the stairs. You 
forgot to sweep there."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Really!? How did you even find that?!

After carefully sweeping up the fallen 
leaves and cleaning the shrine grounds— I 
stood quietly before the altar alongside 
the two of them.
(Clap-clap!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Health comes first... May I run! Strong! 
Forever and ever!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Squeaky clean! Shrine visit's done! 
Now everything is perfect--!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! After all the cleaning King did, 
of course good fortune is guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A divine blessing. Come to think of it— I 
feel like my body's been lighter ever 
since I cleaned up!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yay~!! My wish came true~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Right now, I might even be able 
to run home faster than King-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? Coming on pretty strong, aren't you? 
In that case, care to put it to the test?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: All right! Race ya to the academy~~!!

It seemed to have worked its magic right 
away. Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi completely 
recovered her peak condition.

"However, just as I finished my prayer... 
a gust of wind swept through the shrine!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! Now it's right back to the 
way it was!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Why~? Could it be that God is in a bad 
mood~?!

The two redid the cleaning, but even after 
that, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's condition 
failed to recover...
